name: D-Soccer Flight
summary: Setup, check and firmware update tool for D-Soccer drones (Windows / Mac, works offline).

shots.caption: Main screen: drone status, LED team, sensor calibration and live 3D attitude
Firmware update: pick the file, then Update

releases.changes: Built-in firmware is now drone v1.10.1 and controller v1.2.5 (also on the online list). Update the controller and the drone together. Drone: ESC setup mode is entered only from USB and only while the motors are stopped; gyro re-calibration, reset to defaults, PID defaults, trim reset and motor order changes are refused while flying. Controller: about 36 % faster main loop, the first screen speed (SPD) shows the drone's real speed, vibrator and buzzer queues no longer get stuck, a failed settings save is no longer counted as saved, button release is debounced, unplugging USB while charging turns the controller off. Status tab: the build version shows all three numbers; with a drone connected directly by USB the RF value is packets per second (/s). Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers the same firmware online (no bootloader step).

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Built-in firmware is now drone v1.10.0 and controller v1.2.1 (also on the online list). New drone motor mixer: the throttle stays where the stick is and thrust is straightened with the drone's measured motor curve, so hard roll, pitch and yaw moves no longer lift the drone. PID tab: Throttle Assist (0-100 %, default 0) replaces Attitude Priority; raise it for faster yaw spins and stronger hard moves at the cost of some climb. Thrust Linear (default 100) now means how much of the measured motor curve is used. Yaw heading hold default 3 to 2. Motor order must be 1234 (from drone v1.8.1). Update the controller and the drone together. Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers the same firmware online (no bootloader step).

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Built-in firmware is now drone v1.9.2 and controller v1.2.1 (also on the online list). Drone motor pins now match the app's motor picture with the default order 1234 (1 front-right, 2 rear-right, 3 rear-left, 4 front-left): before the first flight after the update, make sure the motor order is 1234. New motor mixer with thrust linearization and defaults from test flights; the factory test mode is off. PID tab: Thrust Linear and Attitude Priority settings, help on every value, ranges around the defaults; TPA removed. ESC firmware and settings go through the drone (drone v1.8.0 or later). The window title shows the version. Update the controller and the drone together. Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers the same firmware online (no bootloader step).

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Firmware update now also updates the bootloader through the chip's USB update mode (needs controller v1.2.0 or drone v1.7.0, which the same run installs first). On Windows the app offers to install the USB driver for that mode the first time (one administrator prompt). Built-in firmware is now controller v1.2.0 and drone v1.7.0 (also on the online list): 2 kHz drone control with retuned defaults, attitude-mode fix, 1 Mbps fast radio mode, and the controller screen no longer flips, inverts or freezes. Update the controller and the drone together. Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers the same firmware online (no bootloader step).

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Built-in firmware is now controller v1.0.26 and drone v1.3.13 (also on the online list): fixes radio link drops (0.35 s drops about every 20 s on the old hop mode, 1.1 s drops after changing the hop mode, short drops at start-up next to busy Wi-Fi) and the drone yaw rate read with the wrong sign after a hard hit. Update the controller and the drone together. Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers the same firmware online.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).

releases.changes: Controller firmware v1.0.23 (built in and on the online list): left, back and yaw-left work again (v1.0.16 cut negative stick values to 0) and the joystick screen shows MODE1 / MODE2 the right way round. Windows only: on a Mac use the 2.2.11 dmg below, which offers v1.0.23 online.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).
